{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|As you may know, I was honored with the title of first diplomatic legatee, and sent to the second round of talks with Republican negotiators. Nothing came of it, of course; the Senate has dropped even the pretense of debate now, and it's all threats and bluster these days.|The Troxan under-palatine for patriotic liaisons, on his species' attempt to negotiate with the Galactic Republic|<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
The '''first diplomatic legatee''' was a position within the bureaucratic government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troxar]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Troxan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The holder of this office conducted [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]] for [[Gender/Legends|his or her]] planet. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Under-palatine for patriotic liaisons (Clone Wars)|holder]] of the title was simultaneously the [[under-palatine for patriotic liaisons]].<ref name="YDR" />
